note: Personal study manual built from the three RHEL Complete Guides. Structure and chapter order follow the guides exactly. Section text is theirs, carried over as written. Service profiles from the field manual are attached to the chapter they belong under. Currency notes flag verified differences from current practice — they are surfaced, not silently rewritten.
assessment: NOT YET ASSESSED. Step 1 of the brief requires evaluating the learner's own understanding from their answers and practical work. No such data exists yet, so nothing here is personalised to a measured level. Each part ships with its quiz, and completing one records progress, but no inference about ability has been made.

currency.title: The lab is specified as RHEL 8, not RHEL 10
currency.found: Part 0 builds the practice environment on VMware Workstation with a four-machine RHEL 8 topology.
currency.current: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 left mainstream support on 2024-05-31 and is in extended support until 2029-05-31. RHEL 10 is the current major release and is the basis of the RHCSA EX200 exam.
currency.action: Build the lab on RHEL 10. Every command in these guides still applies, but package names, default service enablement and some paths differ between major releases. Keep an RHEL 8 machine only if you specifically need to practise the older behaviour.

currency.title: Stratis and VDO are still taught, but they are not on the RHCSA exam
currency.found: Part 5 covers Stratis layered storage and VDO compression/deduplication in depth.
currency.current: Stratis remains available in RHEL and is a reasonable way to manage layered storage, but the EX200 objective wording is about local storage, LVM, and mounting by UUID or label. VDO is niche and largely absent from enterprise datacentres today.
currency.action: Learn these for understanding, but prioritise the LVM objectives — pvcreate, vgcreate, lvcreate, and mounting by UUID — which are directly examined.

currency.title: EX294 remains the current RHCE exam, but the ecosystem has moved to Ansible Automation Platform
currency.found: The guide configures Ansible from the repository with ansible.cfg and static inventories.
currency.current: EX294 is still the exam for Red Hat Certified Engineer in Ansible Automation. Red Hat has since steered large-scale automation toward Ansible Automation Platform (AAP), which adds a web interface, job scheduling and a controller. The underlying modules and playbook syntax used here are unchanged.
currency.action: Everything in these guides remains valid for EX294. AAP knowledge is useful in industry but is not required for the exam and is not covered here.
